items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Mr. Kimberley, he used to write on the balloon. Yeah. Yeah, I know. I heard of her.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. That's where the beer was coming from. Standing brewery. Oh, yeah. How about the balloons? The balloon station? Huh? Who was going up on the balloon? At that time, they had a couple of people going up there. Women and the balloon. And we came up with this.
Mr. Kimberley, he used to write on the balloon. Yeah. Yeah, I know. I heard of her.
She's the one you said you grew up with her? Yeah. We come up with that. He said he came up with her. No, we live right next door. There was none of that. Yeah.
